summary: Require Docker Engine 28 and Compose 2.33.1 for every node
details: Host checks, doctor and controller startup preflight require stable rootful Linux Docker Engine >=28.0.0 and Docker Compose plugin >=2.33.1 for every P2P profile, including existing IPv4 nodes.
Validate the actual daemon version independently of the CLI, compare version components numerically, and reject rootless and Docker Desktop runtimes.

The host installer preserves an existing Docker installation but fails its final check if that installation is too old; operators must upgrade explicitly. No node data or network identity changes are required.
Document existing miner and syncing joiner upgrades, explicit versus automatic family selection, and the distinction between saving a seed and verifying a live IPv6 peer connection.
operator_actions: Run usdb-node host check before deployment. Upgrade any Docker or Compose installation below the minimum after reviewing container restart impact, then rerun the check.
